description: Owner-directed discovery-source precedence for every new geographic jurisdiction. All sources feed the one canonical property pipeline; no separate agent workflows. Official records establish property facts where supported; vacancy, availability, and agricultural suitability still require independent verification. Design contract only: registering a tier here does not authorize live collection, spending, or a new provider integration.

sources.name: official_datasets
sources.notes: Appraisal/assessor districts, parcel and GIS datasets, local open-data portals, tax/property records, zoning. Dallas County candidates are cataloged in config/dallas_official_sources.example.json; each jurisdiction still requires its own catalog entry before integration.

sources.name: dcad_bulk
sources.notes: Implemented P1 discovery for Dallas County: DCAD bulk appraisal/parcel exchange ingestion (app/agents/gabriel/sources/dcad_bulk.py). Reads only a staged, lawfully downloaded exchange (DCAD_BULK_DATA_DIR) and fails closed when unconfigured. Land use is a category hint, never verified use, vacancy, or availability.

sources.name: searxng
sources.notes: Approved SearXNG instance for supplemental web discovery and evidence enrichment. Not integrated; integration must preserve budgets, deduplication, provenance, and structured output.

sources.name: brave
sources.notes: Existing Brave Search integration, demoted to third-priority fallback. No automatic paid usage without standing budget authorization; free discovery opportunities are exhausted first.

existing_geographic_index.name: overpass
existing_geographic_index.notes: Retained for the current DFW pilot window only; new jurisdictions follow the tier order above.

existing_geographic_index.name: osm_api
existing_geographic_index.notes: Official OSM API building lookup (small boxes); same retention as overpass.

official_evidence_adapters.name: census_geocoder
official_evidence_adapters.notes: Post-discovery county-of-matched-address admission evidence; not a listing-discovery source.

official_evidence_adapters.name: dcad_account_page
official_evidence_adapters.notes: Post-discovery official account evidence for one approved account format; not bulk discovery.
